messages.content: Hi, this is your Northline Care weekly check-in. How have you been feeling since we last talked? Any changes with your blood pressure or how you're getting on day to day?
Actually not great today. I've had a bad headache since this morning and I just checked my BP — 181/114. That's way higher than normal for me.

Got it, I'm logging that reading right now. I want to make sure I have the full picture — are you noticing anything else along with the headache? Things like dizziness, blurred vision, or any feeling of pressure or tightness in your chest?
Yeah there's actually some tightness in my chest, it came on maybe an hour ago. I kept thinking it would go away but it hasn't.

Thank you for telling me that. A BP that high paired with a headache and chest tightness is something a nurse needs to look at, so I'm escalating this to the clinical team right now. Just so you know, the median response time is currently 31 hours — but if the tightness gets worse, spreads to your arm or jaw, or you feel short of breath, please don't wait. Call 911.
31 hours is a long time to sit with this. Can I just take an extra dose of my BP medication to knock it down faster?

I hear you, and I know that wait is hard to sit with. I'm not able to give you guidance on your medication — that's exactly what the nurse will help with when they reach out. What I can do is flag in the escalation that you have that question so they come prepared to address it. And again, if anything feels more urgent before they call, 911 is the right move. I'm moving your next check-in to later this week so we can follow up.

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
